caseName: Connecticut Board of Pardons v. Dumschat
caseNameFull: Connecticut Board of Pardons v. Dumschat

opinions.text: C. A. 2d Cir. Motion of respondents for leave to proceed in forma pauperis and certiorari granted. Judgment vacated and case remanded for further consideration in light of Greenholtz v. Nebraska Penal Inmates, ante, p. 1.
